costGuide.labourLine: Fitting a B20DTH typically takes 8-12 hours at £65-£90/hr (independent) - confirm exact labour when comparing quotes.
paragraphs: What genuinely moves the price for this engine is whether the timing belt has been changed, the condition of the fuel pump, and if the cooling system is intact. Cam belt failure often writes off the engine - a replacement with a full history and new belt kit can save money in the long run . See our full reconditioned engine cost guide.

failures.title: Vauxhall B20DTH Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Timing Belt / Cam Belt Failure - Premature Belt Wear
items.whatHappens: The B20DTH uses a timing belt with a recommended replacement interval of 100,000 miles or 6 years. However, owner reports indicate belts can fail or jump teeth earlier, with plastic idler pulleys cracking and reducing tension. This is an interference engine - if the belt fails, valves and pistons can collide .
items.repairVsReplace: If caught early (belt slip without full failure), replacement of the belt, tensioners, and broken rockers may be sufficient. Full belt failure typically writes off the engine, requiring a full replacement .

items.title: Cooling System Cracks - Expansion Tank Failure
items.whatHappens: The coolant expansion tank is prone to cracking, causing slow coolant loss that can be difficult to trace. Owners report the tank cracking at the bottom, as well as deteriorating coolant hoses .
items.repairVsReplace: Replacement of the expansion tank and affected hoses resolves this. However, ignoring a slow coolant leak can lead to overheating and engine damage.

items.title: Fuel Pump Issues - High-Pressure Diesel Pump Wear
items.whatHappens: The Bosch high-pressure fuel pump (0445010759) can wear over time, particularly if fuel contamination occurs. This is a common failure point across Vauxhall's 2.0 CDTi range .
items.repairVsReplace: Replacement of the fuel pump is required. Early diagnosis via fuel pressure testing can prevent injector damage, which would increase repair costs significantly.

failures.goodYearsLine: The B20DTH has been largely superseded by the D20DTH Euro 6d variant. Later production units (post-2018) have seen improved belt materials and cooling system components, reducing early failure rates .

variants.title: B20DTH Sub-Codes Explained - Which One Is in Your Car?
variants.intro: The B20DTH is also known by its GM code LFS . It is the BiTurbo 170 hp variant of Vauxhall's 2.0-litre diesel family, sitting above the 165 hp D20DTH and below the 206 hp D20DTR BiTurbo. - Fitted to: Insignia A (2015-2017), Zafira C (2014-2017), Cascada (2015-2017) - Key technical difference: 2.0-litre inline-4, 170 hp (125 kW), 400 Nm torque. Compression ratio 16.5:1 . Uses Bosch EDC17 ECU. - Sub-code-specific failure note: Shares the family failure pattern above - timing belt tensioner and cooling system are the primary documented weaknesses. - Interchange note: Not a straight swap with D20DTR (206 hp) - the engine management, fuel system, and turbocharger vary. - Fitted to: Insignia B Grand Sport, Insignia B Sports Tourer (2017-onwards) - Key technical difference: The non-BiTurbo variant, often fitted alongside B20DTH in the Insignia B range. Lower output but similar architecture. - Sub-code-specific failure note: Shares the family timing belt and cooling system concerns. - Interchange note: A suitable replacement but requires ECU calibration changes to match the vehicle's systems.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement B20DTH - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used B20DTH can be a cost-effective option for lower-value Insignia or Astra hosts. However, buyers must verify whether the timing belt has been replaced - a 70,000+ mile unit without belt change carries significant risk. Fuel pump condition is also critical . See our used engine guide.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: A proper reconditioned B20DTH addresses the two major failure modes - the timing belt and cooling system. It should include a new belt kit, water pump, and a full inspection of the fuel system. This is the right call for most owners: the reliability of a new unit at half the price of a new car. See our reconditioned engine guide.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is only justified for B20DTHs in high-value vehicles (low-mileage Insignia Bs, or rare Cascada convertibles). Rebuilds can include upgraded belt components and improved cooling system parts, but the cost often approaches the value of the vehicle . See our rebuilt engine guide.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: We connect you with vetted specialists who can fit the B20DTH across the UK, offering warranties on both parts and labour. See our supply and fit service.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: The B20DTH is fitted to vehicles typically valued between £4,000 and £14,000. A reconditioned engine at £2,800-£4,000 represents 20-40% of the vehicle's value, making replacement a financially sound decision on most examples. Lower-value Insignia A examples (£3,000-£5,000) are approaching the scrap threshold .

items.question: Can I swap another engine code in place of B20DTH?
